# nmr-peaks: `NmrReport`

The `data` payload of `openreadout analyze nmr-peaks DIR_OR_FILE --json` (`--from auto|fid|processed`, `--integrate A:B`), inside the [envelope](envelope.md).

Output of `analyze nmr-peaks`.

JSON Schema: [`docs/schema/nmr-peaks.schema.json`](https://github.com/openreadout/openreadout/blob/main/docs/schema/nmr-peaks.schema.json) · also printed by `openreadout self schema nmr-peaks`.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `path` | `string` | yes | The input path. |
| `format` | `string` | yes | Format id. |
| `source` | `string` | yes | `processed` (a spectrum the vendor software stored) or `fid` (processed here). |
| `trace` | `integer` (uint32) | yes | Trace used (see `info` → `traces[]`). |
| `trace_name` | `string` or `null` |  | Its name. |

| `integrals` | array of [`Integral`](#integral) |  | Integrals of the requested regions. |
| `notes` | array of `string` |  | Remarks. |

## Types

### ProcessingRecord

What was done, with the values actually used.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `steps` | array of `string` | yes | Steps in order, e.g. `zero_fill`, `group_delay`, `apodization`, `fft`, `phase`, `baseline`. |
| `fid_points` | `integer` (uint) | yes | Complex points in the FID. |
| `size` | `integer` (uint) | yes | Transform size, complex points. |
| `apodization` | [`Apodization`](#apodization) or `null` |  | Window applied. |
| `apodization_source` | `string` | yes | Where the window width came from: `stored`, `default`, `option`. |
| `group_delay_points` | `number` (double) | yes | Group delay removed, points. |
| `phase_mode` | `string` | yes | Phase mode actually used: `stored`, `auto`, `manual`, `magnitude`, `none`. |
| `phase0_deg` | `number` (double) | yes | Zero-order phase applied, degrees. |
| `phase1_deg` | `number` (double) | yes | First-order phase applied, degrees. |
| `baseline` | [`BaselineMode`](#baselinemode) | yes | Baseline correction applied. |
| `parameters` | [`FidParameters`](#fidparameters) | yes | Parameters used. |
| `stored` | [`StoredProcessing`](#storedprocessing) | yes | Stored processing values found (may be unused). |
| `notes` | array of `string` |  | Remarks (fallbacks, clamping). |

### Apodization

Window function applied to the FID.

Type: object | object | object.

### BaselineMode

Baseline correction choice.

Type: object | object | object.

### FidParameters

What the processing needs to know about an acquisition.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `spectral_width_hz` | `number` (double) | yes | Spectral width (Hz): the complex sampling rate. |
| `carrier_frequency_mhz` | `number` (double) | yes | Carrier (transmitter) frequency, MHz: the centre of the spectrum. |
| `reference_frequency_mhz` | `number` (double) | yes | Frequency of 0 ppm, MHz (the referencing frequency). |
| `group_delay_points` | `number` (double) | yes | Digital-filter group delay in points (0 when the data carry none). |
| `conjugate` | `boolean` | yes | Complex-conjugate the FID before the transform (reverses the frequency axis). |
| `nucleus` | `string` or `null` |  | Observed nucleus, e.g. `1H`, `13C`. |

### StoredProcessing

Processing parameters the vendor software stored with the data, in this crate's conventions.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `source` | `string` or `null` |  | Where they came from, e.g. `pdata/1/procs` or `procpar`. |
| `size` | `integer` (uint) or `null` |  | Transform size in complex points. |
| `line_broadening_hz` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Exponential line broadening, Hz. |
| `phase0_deg` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Zero-order phase, degrees (`φ0` of the module docs). |
| `phase1_deg` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | First-order phase across the whole spectrum, degrees (`φ1`). |
| `spectrum_stored` | `boolean` |  | True when the vendor software also stored a processed spectrum made with these values. |
| `first_point_factor` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Factor applied to the first FID point (Bruker `FCOR`); `None`: 0.5. |
| `time_domain_points` | `integer` (uint) or `null` |  | Complex FID points the vendor processing used (Bruker `TDeff` / 2); `None`: all. |

### PpmAxis

A regular chemical-shift axis: point `k` is at `first_ppm + k · step_ppm`.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `first_ppm` | `number` (double) | yes | Chemical shift of point 0 (the left, high-frequency edge), ppm. |
| `step_ppm` | `number` (double) | yes | Increment per point, ppm (negative: shifts decrease left to right). |
| `size` | `integer` (uint) | yes | Number of points. |
| `reference_frequency_mhz` | `number` (double) | yes | Frequency of 0 ppm, MHz (converts ppm to Hz). |

### PeakOptions

Peak-picking thresholds.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `min_snr` | `number` (double) | yes | Minimum height as a multiple of the noise SD. |
| `min_height_fraction` | `number` (double) | yes | Minimum height as a fraction of the tallest point in the searched range (0 = off). |
| `min_prominence_snr` | `number` (double) | yes | Minimum prominence as a multiple of the noise SD. |
| `include_negative` | `boolean` | yes | Also report negative peaks. |
| `range_ppm` | array of 2 × any JSON or `null` |  | Only search between these shifts (ppm, either order). |
| `max_peaks` | `integer` (uint) | yes | Keep at most this many peaks (the tallest). |

### Peak

One picked peak.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ppm` | `number` (double) | yes | Chemical shift, ppm (parabolic interpolation). |
| `hz` | `number` (double) | yes | Frequency relative to 0 ppm, Hz. |
| `index` | `integer` (uint) | yes | Index of the maximum point. |
| `height` | `number` (double) | yes | Interpolated height (negative for negative peaks). |
| `width_hz` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Full width at half height, Hz (`None` when overlapping lines hide the half-height point). |
| `width_ppm` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | Full width at half height, ppm. |
| `snr` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | |height| / noise SD (`None` when the noise SD is 0). |

One integral.

| field | type | always present | description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `from_ppm` | `number` (double) | yes | High-shift end of the region, ppm. |
| `to_ppm` | `number` (double) | yes | Low-shift end of the region, ppm. |
| `value` | `number` (double) | yes | Sum of the points × point spacing (intensity·ppm). |
| `normalized` | `number` (double) or `null` |  | `value` rescaled so the reference region has the reference value (`None` when the reference integral is 0 or missing). |
